connectionSpecification.description: Reads a Shopify store through the Admin GraphQL API with the access token of a custom app, or the client credentials of a Dev Dashboard app installed on the store.

access_token.description: Admin API access token of a custom app installed on the store, sent in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header. Leave empty when using client_id and client_secret.
access_token.title: Admin API Access Token

client_id.description: Client ID of a Dev Dashboard app installed on the store. The connector exchanges it with client_secret for an access token (client credentials grant). Leave empty when using access_token.
client_id.title: Client ID

client_secret.description: Client secret of the Dev Dashboard app of client_id.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

shop.description: The store name or its myshopify.com domain. Custom domains are not accepted.
shop.title: Shop

start_date.description: Earliest update time read: an RFC 3339 time or YYYY-MM-DD, in UTC. Empty reads from the shop's creation.
start_date.title: Start Date

window_days.description: Days of updates one query of an incremental sync reads; the sync saves its state after each window. A full refresh reads in one run. 1 to 365, default 30.
window_days.title: Window Days

connectionSpecification.title: Shopify Source Spec
